messages:
Mara: Quick sync — I opened a PR to rework the function & tool-calling guide to prefer structured-output patterns. Need reviewers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3424
Sachin: ack. what's changed at high level?
Mara: condensed the examples into three canonical patterns: (1) strict JSON schema + validator, (2) hybrid natural-language + schema, (3) best-effort parsing with fallback. Reworked code samples to use the SDK v1.3 function-calling helper and added an example for streaming + schema validation.
Alex P.: can you paste the new schema for the 'order' example here? want to check field names for SDK snippet.
Mara: sure —

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"}}},"required":["order_id","items"]}}
```

(also flagged a small typo in the notes about 'required' placement)

eva: FYI — the Node SDK snippet uses `client.callTool(...)` in the PR but our current package exports `client.invokeTool(...)` on v1.3. we should keep both examples or add a note to migrate.
Mara: good catch — updated PR to include both forms and a migration note. I also added a small script under 'examples/migrate-tool-calling.sh' in the repo that maps the old call to the new API.
Sachin: can we add a short section on guardrails: suggest using `parse_schema: strict|lax` + fallback prompt? reviewers often miss this.
Mara: added a 'Guardrails' subsection with recommended configs and suggested telemetry hooks. Example snippet:

```json
{"parse_mode":"strict","on_fail":"return_error","fallback_prompt":"Please reformat output to match JSON schema: {{schema}}"}
```

docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/function-tool-calling#structured-output — includes schema validation demo (mara)
Alex P.: Left inline comments about naming (sku vs product_id) and updated the SDK snippet to use `product_id` — prefer to align with existing inventory docs.
Mara: updated to `product_id` and pushed. Also added a small test harness under `docs/test-examples/tool-calling/parse_test.py` that runs the schema validator against sample responses.
eva: small nit — links in the migration guide point to the old `examples/` path. can we use relative links `/docs/examples/...` so they work in the staging site? Also the embed for streaming includes `await client.stream...` which needs an `async` wrapper in the snippet.
Mara: fixed links and added async wrapper. request: @Sachin @Alex P. can you each do a pass for 1) accuracy, 2) SDK API wording, 3) short migration checklist items? hoping to merge by EOD.
Sachin: I can do accuracy pass now.
Alex P.: I'll check SDK wording + update the Python snippet to use `client.tools.invoke()`.
Mara: thanks! If no blockers I'll merge after approvals. small ask — watch for examples that auto-run in CI; I disabled network calls and added a local mock service in the test harness. :thumbsup: 
eva: approved from my side once async snippet fixed. :rocket: 
Sachin: one tiny comment on the schema: `items` -> `minItems:1`? Can you add that? otherwise LGTM.
Mara: added `minItems:1` and pushed. final CI green on staging preview.
Alex P.: LGTM. merging in 10m unless anyone objects.
Mara: merging — thanks all! :tada: 
docs-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3424 — deployed to production docs.
